competences.description: Quickly draws the sword to attack the enemy, decreasing the target's Defense for 2 turns with a 50% chance. This skill has a 20% chance to activate the Sword of the Supreme Sky Wolf after using the skill on your turn, and the activation chance increases by 10% additionally when you land a Critical Hit.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

competences.description: Swiftly attacks the enemy 2 times, leaving Continuous Damage for 2 turns. This skill has a 30% chance to activate the Sword of the Supreme Sky Wolf after using the skill on your turn, and the activation chance increases by 20% additionally when you land a Critical Hit.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 2 times with the energy of pitch-black darkness. Each attack deals 25% increased damage if the enemy is under harmful effects, and deals 30% more damage if the target has light attribute. This skill has a 70% chance to activate the Sword of the Supreme Sky Wolf after using the skill on your turn, and the activation chance increases by 30% additionally when you land a Critical Hit.

effets.description: Increases damage per debuff on the target

competences.nom: Sword of the Supreme Sky Wolf
competences.description: Attacks all enemies with a secret skill. Enemies defeated by this attack cannot be revived during battle. Gains a turn instantly if [Sword of the Supreme Sky Wolf] is activated. Sword of the Supreme Sky Wolf persists until the skill is used or the caster is defeated.

effets.description: Prevents an enemy from being resurrected after being killed.
